notes: Conference sponsor/exhibitor pages to scrape for hardware-aligned prospects. Each entry: name, type, sponsor/exhibitor list URL, scrape strategy, lastScrapedAt. Add/edit as Brian discovers more relevant events. Defense-only and S/W-only conferences are intentionally excluded — those would belong in a separate S/W lead-research agent.

conferences.name: DesignCon
conferences.notes: Chip design, PCB, signal integrity. Strong ICP overlap with HWFYI subscribers.

conferences.name: SEMICON West
conferences.notes: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment + materials. SEMI association.

conferences.name: IMTS
